summary: Jushi Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its 2026 Annual General and Special Meeting held June 24, 2026. Items 5.07 and 8.01 detail the results of shareholder votes on routine matters: setting board size at five, electing directors, ratifying auditors, and passing a special resolution to approve a plan of arrangement for continuance and domestication from British Columbia to Nevada. This is a standard governance update with no transaction, tender offer, acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. The filing is a routine current report with no special-situation characteristics.
